name: Thai Green Curry Soup with Chicken, Noodles, Mushrooms & Green Beans

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add mushrooms, curry paste, and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms start to soften, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp virgin coconut oil
3 (227g ) pkg sliced white mushrooms
⅓ cup Thai curry paste, green
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add broth to the pot. Stir to combine, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat.
While the soup comes to a boil, place chickens on a cutting board and, using your hands, remove meat from the skin and bones. Separate the meat into shred-like pieces.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (850 g) whole chicken rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat

instructions.primary_message: Once the soup is boiling, uncover, then add chicken and rice noodles; stir to combine. Reduce heat to medium and simmer, stirring occasionally, until noodles are almost soft, 8-10 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry green beans. Using a clean cutting board, trim and cut green beans crosswise into 1-inch pieces.
When the noodles are almost soft, add green beans. Continue to cook until noodles and beans are tender, 3-4 minutes more.
Wash, dry, and juice limes into the soup. Stir to combine and remove from heat.
To serve, divide soup between bowls. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: rotisserie chicken, white and dark meat
